latest_release.name: DroidDeck 0.7.0
latest_release.body:
**DroidDeck is 100% open source. No ads. No telemetry. No proprietary components. No source withheld.** Since 0.6.9, **39 people** sent **194 pull requests**, and **20 of them are first-time contributors**. Our community is strongest when we can build together, and with DroidDeck 0.7.0, our community is about to get A LOT bigger! 0.7.0 introduces preliminary support for **Mali, PowerVR and Xclipse** GPUs! In addition, we now have GameJolt library and store, dual screen game mode + KDE Desktop, Syncthing integration, improvements for devices with low ram, customizable controller profiles and presets, hardware mouse & keyboard support, live wallpapers, and even more. Click the link in the comments below to... I mean scroll down to learn more: ### Features

- Initial **Mali, PowerVR and Xclipse support**. DroidDeck detects the GPU and picks a driver for it, so these devices can run sessions, with MaliBridge and Venus on Mali and open driver pairs elsewhere. (@ASEbrahim, @mr-abccc, @The412Banner, @wallentx, @Leask, @stefanz92, @DavidCimo, @maxjivi05, @K11MCH1, @xXJSONDeruloXx, [#1587](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/1587), [#2027](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2027), [#1950](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/1950), [#2029](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2029), [#2157](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2157))

- Added the **KDE desktop on the bottom screen** beside a Steam session or a game, next to Dashboard, Keyboard + trackpad, Terminal and Deck grips. (@xXJSONDeruloXx, [#1966](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/1966)) - Added **swap screens**: play on the bottom screen while the top screen shows the Dashboard or the desktop. Use the swap button in the panel bar or **Show the game on** in the session menu. (@The412Banner, [#2006](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/2006))

- Added **shared Steam libraries with other pc gaming apps**. DroidDeck can now **find Steam libraries that other apps already made** on your internal storage or card and suggests them, each with its game count, so one install of a game can serve both apps. You can add up to four more libraries beside internal storage and the card, rename them, and remove them any time. (@xXJSONDeruloXx, [#1967](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/pull/1967), [#2023](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/

detail.readme_excerpt:
DroidDeck brings the SteamOS experience to Android: Steam Gaming Mode, full Linux desktop, integration with GOG, Epic Games, Xbox, and other storefronts, Steam VR, and more!

100% open source. No ads. No telemetry. No proprietary components. No source withheld.

> DroidDeck has no website. Only download it from this repository's [Releases](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/releases).

## Install 1. Android 9 or newer on Adreno 730 or newer, or any 8xx. Adreno 6xx is experimental. Mali, Xclipse, PowerVR and Adreno 710 are unsupported. No root needed. 2. About 3 GB free for the runtime, plus 1.1 GB for the desktop and emulators. 3.
